full.description: This image is a gross pathology specimen of the small or large intestine. It shows multiple well-defined mucosal ulcers, some of which appear as "flask-shaped" or necrotic lesions typical of amoebic colitis. The lesions involve the intestinal mucosa and submucosa, showing characteristic areas of ulceration and hemorrhage. The appearance is consistent with intestinal amoebiasis (amoebic dysentery) caused by Entamoeba histolytica.
